scope: explicit 208896+3x65536, maximum constants used for conservative accounting
known_limits: Named payload bound excludes allocator bookkeeping/fragmentation, strings and std::function objects.
CUDA pageable-copy internals are not isolated by allocator counters; whole-host physical RAM/RSS telemetry remains authoritative for observation.
Original target/draft KV and recurrent state remain in fixed slot allocations; SSD entries do not add another RAM state image.
Save prefix copying and I/O are serialized under the model/cache mutexes, so this temporary is not multiplied by active slots.
